Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 14  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Full Moon (C) occurs with the highest frequency" based on the assumption that sunrise occurs only once per year at polar regions. This assumption was a misinterpretation of the data and failed to account for the fact that sunrise occurs daily for the vast majority of locations on Earth, except for the poles, which have unique day-night cycles. The task was to determine the most frequent natural event globally, not specifically at the poles, and sunrise is clearly the most frequent event globally as it occurs daily across most of the planet. This misunderstanding led to the incorrect final answer.
